description: Informal worship gatherings lead to autonomous Shrine and Temple construction; physical attendance and real Priest/Oracle contact without any building faith/DP/Presence buff.
designNotes: Buildings require actual resident demand, resources and labor; player cannot place them.
Attendance uses walkable seven-cell paths and enters shared five-cell physical contact tracking.
Core footprints do not overlap; religious influence may overlap.
No direct Devotion, Divine Power, or Divine Presence bonuses for structures.
Temple construction gate intentionally disabled for v1; hostile miracles and social risk are future playtests.
